 Follow Janelle Brown and Peter Share Their Love Story in First Joint Interview
 Lucille Barilla Fri, November 6, 2026 at 11:26 AM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Janelle Brown and Peter Share Their Love Story in First Joint Interview Sister Wives fans have watched Janelle Brown embrace her independence, build a life on her own terms, and redefine what happiness looks like since splitting from Kody Brown almost five years ago.
 Now, the beloved TLC star is opening up the page to a whole new chapter. In her very first in-depth joint interview with her new partner, Peter , Janelle is giving viewers an inside look at the relationship that has brought a fresh sense of joy into her post-plural marriage life. From how they connected to what makes their bond so strong, the telling sit-down reveals what's next for the 57-year-old reality star.
 Taking to Instagram to share a special message with TLC cameras, Janelle and Peter opened up about their bond and gave viewers a quick preview of what's ahead. Fans won't have to wait long to see the spark for themselves, as their relationship takes center stage.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The video clip was captioned, "Meet the new man in Janelle's life!"
 Parade Daily🎬 SIGN UP for Parade's Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬  
 "We first met at a blind date that my friend Alice set up for me in Vegas," Janelle began. "I don't know it worked out, but I was super awkward."
 Peter added, "Alice got in touch with me, wanting to go on a date. I said, 'Is it Italian food?' She said, 'Yes.' I said, 'I'm in.'"
 He continued that his first impression of Janelle was "very kind, honest, open. An amazing woman."
 She added, "I caught his eye a couple of times during dinner, and I said, 'Wait, what do I see here?' There was something there."
 Advertisement Advertisement The couple's relationship remains long-distance. "It was all talking and texting and it was really easy," the Sister Wives star shared.
 Peter said that their conversations "just flowed naturally" and that experience was "new" for him. Janelle agreed, saying this relationship was "different than anything I have ever had before. It was easy to kind of move forward."
 Previously, Janelle was married to Kody and her first husband was sister wife Meri Brown 's brother, Adam Barber .
 The reality star said she was "excited for the future because I think its bright." Peter added that he and Janelle have a "great connection. We are both open and honest with each other and we say what's on our mind. We smile at the end of the day and I look forward to seeing her in the morning."
 Advertisement Advertisement Janelle and Peter went Instagram-official with their relationship in August 2026.
 Watching Janelle build a life that feels entirely her own has been one of the best parts of following Sister Wives over the last few years. After everything she's navigated, seeing her comfortable, smiling, and stepping into something new with Peter is a great outcome.
